basis.importantCaveat: These are management scenarios, not statistically validated platform-wide probabilities. Current observed sales are zero, public URLs are not yet independently verified for tracked paid products, and organic search/discovery starts from a low base.

currentPortfolioSnapshot.booth: 1 completed flow + 2 queued in metrics snapshot
currentPortfolioSnapshot.note: 1 completed flow + 2 queued in metrics snapshot

conservative.interpretation: Most products receive little traffic; no clear winner emerges.

base.interpretation: A few products sell intermittently, bundles increase AOV, and free tools/note begin contributing discovery.

upside.interpretation: One or two strong product-category winners emerge and are successfully expanded into bundles/licenses/cross-listing.

weightedManagementExpectation.warning: Do not budget personal spending from the weighted figure; upside is highly skewed. Use conservative/base cases for planning.

assessment.currentSystemAloneIsEnoughFor: small side-income experiment and product-market discovery
assessment.primaryBottleneck: distribution and verified conversion evidence, not production capacity

revenueGates.trigger: 14 days after at least 2 paid BOOTH products are verified live and 0 observed paid transactions across BOOTH/note
automaticActions: pause near-duplicate expansion in the same categories
rewrite the strongest paid-product title/description/preview plan before lowering price
prioritize one genuinely useful free funnel per strongest buyer problem
publish problem-focused note discovery content rather than another similar paid SKU

revenueGates.trigger: trailing 30-day observed gross revenue < 5000 JPY OR fewer than 3 paid transactions after at least 2 paid products are verified live
automaticActions: shift strategy priority from SKU expansion to distribution/funnel improvement
create at most one BOOTH free Lite product for the strongest category if absent and technically supported
create or improve category landing pages and internal links
prioritize bundle/AOV improvement only when complementary paid products are live
revenueGates.humanAction: if BOOTH has at least 2 live products, request a one-time GA4 connection because traffic/conversion data becomes more valuable than more products

revenueGates.trigger: trailing 30-day observed gross revenue < 10000 JPY at day 60
automaticActions: freeze weak categories for 30 days
focus production on the top 1-2 buyer problems by observed clicks/sales/messages
prepare English localization only for the strongest plausible product
research one external marketplace that adds discovery or a new buyer segment; do not choose solely on low fees
revenueGates.humanAction: ask for one-time account setup only if the expected value of the chosen external channel clearly exceeds setup burden

revenueGates.trigger: trailing 30-day observed gross revenue < 20000 JPY at day 90
automaticActions: create an organization/team license for the strongest B2B-suitable product only if at least one sale or strong usage evidence exists
prioritize one high-AOV bundle over several new low-price products
audit whether free tools target purchase-intent problems rather than only informational traffic
evaluate affiliate or recurring revenue only where traffic/demand evidence exists
revenueGates.humanAction: none unless external payment/account verification is justified

revenueGates.trigger: trailing 30-day observed gross revenue < 30000 JPY at day 180
automaticActions: classify current passive-template model as insufficient for compensation-level income
stop expanding low-converting categories

run a fresh business-model search for a different monetization class: higher-ticket low-touch digital licensing, secure paid micro-tool/SaaS, affiliate-led search assets, or a marketplace with stronger discovery
preserve profitable existing products but redirect new build capacity to the best alternative model
revenueGates.humanAction: request only the minimum one-time setup required for the selected replacement model

trafficConversionDecisionRulesAfterAnaly.note: Thresholds below are internal management rules, not asserted industry benchmarks.
trafficConversionDecisionRulesAfterAnaly.lowTraffic: If a paid page gets <100 relevant visits/month, treat distribution as the main bottleneck.
trafficConversionDecisionRulesAfterAnaly.trafficButNoSales: If a paid page gets >=300 relevant visits/month and conversion remains <0.5%, prioritize offer, preview, positioning, trust, and pricing experiments rather than more traffic.
trafficConversionDecisionRulesAfterAnaly.promisingConversion: If observed purchase conversion is >=1% with enough sample size, prioritize traffic scaling and complementary offers.
trafficConversionDecisionRulesAfterAnaly.winner: If a product/category generates repeated purchases across multiple weeks, deepen the category before unrelated expansion.
